Name: New NPC Simay
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
[size=4]Today (June 27th) is National HIV Testing Day. As such, I'd like to introduce Simay, the valley's first HIV+ resident![/size]

[size=4]This mod was a bit of a special project to me because, as you may or may not know, I am an AIDS patient irl. This mod is a bit of a self-insertion to raise awareness and fight stigma surrounding the condition.[/size]

[size=4]That's not to say the mod is all serious and doom and gloom though! Simay is quite a fun character. She's quirky and friendly with a wide range of interests. She's friends with Abby, Seb, Sam, and Emily, and lives in the furthest upper right corner room of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47209]Saloon Basement[/url]. She's romanceable and comes with full dialogue, schedule, and optional seasonal outfits. She has events at 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 10, and 14 hearts! Get to know the valley's new rainbow-haired goth![/size]

[size=4]Gift tastes: [/size]
[spoiler][size=4]Loved: coffee, triple shot espresso, rainbow shell, strawberry, ice cream, cheese, pumpkin, spaghetti, cookies, chocolate cake, amethyst, prismatic shard, pumpkin pie[/size]
[size=4]Liked: opal, fire opal, tigerseye, obsidian, fairy stone, star shards, pizza, hashbrowns, sunflower, tulip, summer spangle, fairy rose[/size]
[size=4]Disliked: green tea, any alcohol[/size]
[size=4]Hates: any mushrooms or fish, mushroom dishes or seafood[/size][/spoiler]

[size=4]Heart Events Guide:[/size]
[spoiler][size=4]2 hearts: walk into town on a sunny day between 6 am and noon
3 hearts: Enter Haley and Emily's house
4 hearts: Enter the clinic between 9 am and 1 pm
5 hearts: Enter Sebastian's room
6 hearts: Go to the mountains
7 hearts: Enter Pierre's between 1 am and 3 pm
8 hearts: Enter the clinic between 10 am and 3 pm
10 hearts: Enter the Saloon between 4 pm and 10 pm
14 hearts: Go to town between 9 am and 2 pm[/size][/spoiler]

[size=4]This mod requires: [/size]
[size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47209]Saloon Attic and Basement[/url][/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20597][size=4]Therapist NPC[/size][/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47688][size=4]Extra Saloon Space[/size][/url]

[size=4]Credit for art goes to jazzybee and Poltergeister for the overall look, me for some editing to customize her, and Huskyn1nja for the sprites. Assets for her room are from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27454?tab=description]Luny's Wizard Furniture Recolor[/url] which had open permissions. [/size]

[size=4]Enjoy![/size]
